name: Seiri Danshi no Nichijou
source:
The main character, Kirito, had a childhood friend called Hiroaki.
Hiroaki has heavy menstrual cramps and is always full on menstrual days.
Kirito has a light period, so I don't understand why Hiroaki gets frustrated at every period.
Frustrated by the menstrual and emotionally unstable Hiroaki, Kirito just yells at him!

[Taken from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/24909]Freem![/url]]
translation:
主角Kirito有个名叫Hiroaki的竹马。

Hiroaki痛经严重，每到经期就总是气鼓鼓的。

Kirito的经期症状很轻，无法理解Hiroaki为什么每次来月经都会烦躁。

面对因经期而情绪不稳的Hiroaki，Kirito也渐渐不耐烦，终于忍不住冲他吼了出来！

[摘自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/24909]Freem![/url]]
